retry_proposal.jitter: uniform [0.8,1.2] times delay; respect longer structured Retry-After; never exceed deadline
retry_proposal.manual_recovery: new causally linked task after evidence review; no blind reset, targeting/order override, new provider key or reopening completed task
retry_proposal.migration_age_policy: failure/dependency age begins on new-engine admission or explicit reviewed import; historical timestamps do not instantly exhaust new budget

lease_proposal.scope: single canonical operation lease; renewal before expiry with same token/generation; no revival after expiry
lease_proposal.handover: drain then increment authority generation; all legacy commit paths must participate before any new authority

phase2_design: all fixtures have explicit expected facts/effects and current evidence or future-only label
phase3_shadow: 100% deterministic fixture equivalence with target adapter
0 duplicate Stripe objects across lost-response/concurrency tests
100% stale token/generation/engine rejection under disposable PostgreSQL concurrency
crash at every transaction boundary leaves either all or none
handover plus rollback tested for access, checkout and Finance
0 shadow provider mutations or customer-visible writes
staging_cutover: 7 consecutive days shadow and at least 100 synthetic complete event families
100% reconciled task coverage; no unreviewed attention items
one-engine commit barrier proven at database level
fresh monthly/annual/cancel/payment-failure/reconciliation acceptance with no manual worker
production_cutover: 14 consecutive days shadow and at least 1000 synthetic or natural complete families; synthetic evidence labelled separately
0 unexplained business effects or ownership mismatches
100% audited handover/rollback rehearsal; old engine caught up before rollback
reviewed production isolation, backups, retention, on-call and reconciliation capacity plan
explicit operator approval; cohort 1% then 10% then 100% with at least 24h and zero unresolved mismatches per stage
